title: Grilled Courgette Skewers with Aussie Flair
description: A simple and flavorful summer recipe from Australia, perfect for a quick and easy dinner. This dish is all about showcasing the freshness of courgettes and the smokiness of the grill.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread 4-5 slices of courgette onto each skewer.
Brush the courgettes with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Optional: Serve with a side of quinoa or couscous for a complete meal.
